line.text: Nyx sent you? Good. This city needs more people making music, not more people selling subscriptions to it. I'll keep your name on the list.
line.direction: Casual direct address to a trusted local; understated, sincere.

voice.direction: Original adult venue host, warm and dry, pragmatic underground musician, no celebrity likeness.
